extracted.name: Carrot, Potato, and Cabbage Soup
extracted.description: This hearty carrot, potato, and cabbage soup with onion, garlic, and savory seasonings is quick and simple to prepare. Make a big batch to freeze.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 medium head green cabbage, thinly sliced
instruction_lines: Combine carrots, potatoes, onion, cabbage, and garlic in a stockpot over medium-high heat. Pour in chicken stock and olive oil, then season with salt, parsley, thyme, basil, and pepper.
Bring to a simmer and cook until carrots are tender, about 20 minutes. Transfer to a blender in small batches and blend until smooth.
